footer.tagline: First aid steps, guidance and access to healthcare professionals. In case of immediate danger, contact the emergency services first.
footer.ctaDescription: MediSecours+ gives you access to a network of certified doctors, validated protocols and a real-time infrastructure to support you through the most critical moments.
footer.newsletterTitle: Sign up to receive health tips.
footer.newsletterConsent: By signing up, you accept our Privacy Policy and consent to receiving updates from our platform.

hero.title: MediSecours helps you choose your next step.
hero.subtitle: First aid steps, symptom guidance, finding a centre or a medical consultation: start from the person's actual situation.
hero.disclaimer: If the person is unresponsive, not breathing normally or bleeding heavily, call the emergency services immediately. Do not waste time filling in a form.

how.title: How to use MediSecours
how.description: First aid, guidance and finding centres are available without an account. A patient account is only needed to consult a doctor and keep track of your follow-up.
how.observeDesc: Check whether the person responds, breathes normally and is in immediate danger.
how.chooseDesc: Open first aid, symptom guidance or a medical consultation.
how.followDesc: Call the emergency services, apply a temporary gesture or contact a professional.
how.disclaimer: MediSecours helps you recognise an emergency level and choose a pathway. The platform does not replace the emergency services and does not make a diagnosis in place of a doctor.

guide.title: Using MediSecours, step by step.
guide.description: Find only the information you need to use the platform as a visitor, patient or doctor.
guide.dangerTitle: In case of life-threatening danger, contact the emergency services first.
guide.dangerDesc: Do not wait for a reply in the messaging and do not fill in a form before calling.
guide.visitorTitle: Discover the platform as a visitor
guide.visitorDesc: These services are available immediately, without creating an account.
guide.patientTitle: Request a consultation and keep track of it
guide.patientDesc: The patient account allows you to contact a doctor and find your exchanges.
guide.medecinTitle: Handle requests and follow your patients
guide.medecinDesc: The doctor account brings together consultations, messages and follow-up documents.
guide.v1.title: Consult the first aid guides
guide.v1.desc: Search for a situation, open the corresponding sheet and follow the steps shown in order. Also check the actions to avoid and the urgency level.
guide.v2.title: Get oriented from your symptoms
guide.v2.desc: Describe the signs observed to get guidance and identify the appropriate level of care. This feature does not replace a medical diagnosis.
guide.v3.title: Find a health centre
guide.v3.desc: Search available facilities, filter them by your need and use their location to prepare your trip.
guide.v4.title: Discover the doctors
guide.v4.desc: Check professional profiles, specialities and availability. A patient account will only be required when sending a consultation request.
guide.p1.title: Create your patient account
guide.p1.desc: Enter your identity, email address and a strong password. Optional medical information can be added now or later from your profile.
guide.p2.title: Confirm your email address
guide.p2.desc: Open the message received after registering and click the confirmation link. Check your spam folder if the message does not appear.
guide.p3.title: Request and track a consultation
guide.p3.desc: Choose a doctor, describe your need, then follow the request status: pending, in progress, completed or cancelled.
guide.p4.title: Exchange with the doctor
guide.p4.desc: Once the consultation is accepted, use the associated conversation to send your messages and any documents useful for the care.
guide.p5.title: Check the notifications and follow-up
guide.p5.desc: Notifications tell you about new messages and changes to your consultations. Opening the relevant item marks the information as read.
guide.p6.title: Report a behaviour
guide.p6.desc: From a doctor's profile, use the report button, choose a reason and describe the facts precisely. You will find the report and its reply in your profile.
guide.d1.title: Create a complete professional profile
guide.d1.desc: Choose the doctor account, state your speciality and order number, then provide the required documents.
guide.d1.detail1: CNI: readable photo of the front and back.
guide.d1.detail2: Passport: readable photo of the identity page.
guide.d1.detail3: Recent photo of your face, facing forwards, sharp and without filter.
guide.d2.title: Wait for the profile to be activated
guide.d2.desc: After confirming your email address, your profile goes through a compliance check. You receive a message when professional access is activated.
guide.d3.title: Handle consultation requests
guide.d3.desc: Check the reason sent by the patient, then accept or decline the request. The filters help you quickly find consultations by their status.
guide.d4.title: Run the exchanges
guide.d4.desc: Use the messaging linked to the consultation to gather the necessary information and pass on your instructions to the patient.
guide.d5.title: Document the care
guide.d5.desc: Add the required prescriptions and reports. The My patients section contains only the people with whom a consultation has been carried out.
guide.faq1.q: Do I need an account to consult the first aid guides?
guide.faq1.a: No. First aid, orientation, health centres and the list of doctors are all accessible without registering.
guide.faq2.q: Why is my doctor account not immediately accessible?
guide.faq2.a: Professional profiles go through a compliance check before activation to protect patients and professionals.
guide.faq3.q: What should I do if I do not receive the confirmation email?
guide.faq3.a: Check your spam folder, confirm that the address entered is correct, then use the resend option on the login page.
guide.faq4.q: What should I do if I forget my password?
guide.faq4.a: Use the Forgot password link on the login page and follow the instructions received by email.
guide.faq5.q: How do I report a doctor?
guide.faq5.a: Open their profile, select Report, choose the reason and describe the facts. The follow-up of your report then appears in your profile.
guide.faq6.q: What should I do in case of immediate danger?
guide.faq6.a: Call the emergency services without waiting for a reply in the messaging or an online consultation.
guide.endDesc: Go back to the home page to choose the service that matches your situation.
